name: npm/@modelcontextprotocol/server-memory
title: Knowledge Graph Memory
description: Persistent knowledge-graph memory: entities and relationships stored locally for context across sessions.

toolsSummary.name: create_entities
toolsSummary.description: Add named entities to the in-memory knowledge graph.

toolsSummary.name: search_nodes
toolsSummary.description: Query nodes in the graph by name or other attributes.

io.sami/gallery.about: The reference MCP memory server stores a local entity–relation graph in a JSON file (path configurable) so sessions can build up structured long-term context.

environmentVariables.name: MEMORY_FILE_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the memory storage file (default: memory.jsonl in the server directory; see upstream README).
